Debug.Name: Enable Debug
Debug.Hint: Prints detailed step-by-step logs to the browser console for every minion damage event. Leave this off for normal play.

Diagnostics.Name: Run Diagnostics
Diagnostics.Label: Run Diagnostics
Diagnostics.Hint: Runs a self-test of the module's rules engine and lets you download a report to share when asking for help.

Flag.Name: Minion
Flag.Hint: This actor is treated as a Minion by the Minion! module: reduced to 0 HP by the Minion trait, eligible for overkill.

Overkill.Title: Minion! - Overkill
Overkill.Intro: {attacker} hits {target} with {weapon} and deals enough damage to involve other minions.
Overkill.NoCandidates: No other minion in range: overkill only affects the target already hit.
Overkill.Shortfall: The excess damage would be enough for {count} more minion(s), but there are no others in range.

Chat.OneMore: {attacker} lands an overkill! Besides {target}, one more enemy falls.
Chat.ManyMore: {attacker} lands an overkill! Besides {target}, {count} more enemies fall.

Notify.SceneNotViewed: Minion! overkill skipped: the GM is not viewing the scene where the attack happened.

Diagnostics.Title: Minion! - Diagnostics
Diagnostics.Failed: Engine self-test: {passed}/{total} passed, {failed} failed. Please attach the full report when asking for help.
Diagnostics.SaveHint: Click "Save Report" to download the full diagnostics file.
